meta.description: A bound and passive situation leads to a static outcome.

units.displayText: The Oasis, Ops Room.

spans.text: The Oasis, Ops Room.

units.rawText: After the impact, some agents are just coming back online, like you, and are awaiting orders. You can issue commands to them directly.

units.displayText: Thank goodness you're here. Leave the rest to me.

spans.text: Thank goodness you're here. Leave the rest to me.

units.rawText: Think nothing of it. I just happened to be reporting in with the engineering team here.

units.rawText: ...But you, are you really okay, Persicaria?
units.displayText: ...But you, are you really okay, Persicaria?

spans.text: ...But you, are you really okay, Persicaria?

units.rawText: What is it?
units.displayText: What is it?

units.rawText: Your eyes... They're discoloring. It's not that obvious, but I can see that murkiness beneath all the data streams.
units.displayText: Your eyes... They're discoloring. It's not that obvious, but I can see that murkiness beneath all the data streams.

units.rawText: Your neural cloud is—

units.rawText: I'm fine.
units.displayText: I'm fine.

spans.text: I'm fine.

units.displayText: Persicaria smiles, looking past Horizon. Countless notices accompanied by dark red frames continue to appear, the vast central display in the room now gasping for space.

spans.text: Persicaria smiles, looking past Horizon. Countless notices accompanied by dark red frames continue to appear, the vast central display in the room now gasping for space.

units.rawText: In front of it, the chair the Professor so often occupied lies empty, and a familiar sound seems to ring out to her.
units.displayText: In front of it, the chair the Professor so often occupied lies empty, and a familiar sound seems to ring out to her.

spans.text: In front of it, the chair the Professor so often occupied lies empty, and a familiar sound seems to ring out to her.

units.rawText: I believe in you, Persicaria.
units.displayText: I believe in you, Persicaria.

spans.text: I believe in you, Persicaria.

units.rawText: I can do it. Trust me.
units.displayText: I can do it. Trust me.

spans.text: I can do it. Trust me.

units.rawText: Persicaria takes a deep breath.
units.displayText: Persicaria takes a deep breath.

spans.text: Persicaria takes a deep breath.

units.rawText: I've been through worse. When the Sanctifiers invaded the Oasis, we lost many that were close to us, and what was once our home lay in ruin.
units.displayText: I've been through worse. When the Sanctifiers invaded the Oasis, we lost many that were close to us, and what was once our home lay in ruin.

spans.text: I've been through worse. When the Sanctifiers invaded the Oasis, we lost many that were close to us, and what was once our home lay in ruin.

units.rawText: But no matter what, we pulled through. It will be the same this time. Even if you aren't here...
units.displayText: But no matter what, we pulled through. It will be the same this time. Even if you aren't here...

spans.text: But no matter what, we pulled through. It will be the same this time. Even if you aren't here...

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

spans.text: You...

units.rawText: Persicaria lowers her head, her tone softening and eyes casting downwards.
units.displayText: Persicaria lowers her head, her tone softening and eyes casting downwards.

spans.text: Persicaria lowers her head, her tone softening and eyes casting downwards.

units.rawText: I must stand here. The Professor's not here. There is only me.
units.displayText: I must stand here. The Professor's not here. There is only me.

spans.text: I must stand here. The Professor's not here. There is only me.

units.rawText: Inform every department. I'm back. Reroute all messages to me. Horizon, we're low on manpower. Please help me with processing the intel.

units.rawText: ...Understood.
units.displayText: ...Understood.

units.displayText: As Horizon contacts respective departments, the sounds of emergency requests arrive one after the other in the Ops Room.

units.rawText:
You're finally here, Persi!
The Medical Department needs hands, as many as possible! We're hopelessly swamped here.
units.displayText:
You're finally here, Persi!

You're finally here, Persi!

units.displayText: A second. Bonee has just restored communications, and she's on her way to you with five—

spans.text: A second. Bonee has just restored communications, and she's on her way to you with five—

units.rawText: Hold on just a second, five?
units.displayText: Hold on just a second, five?

spans.text: Hold on just a second, five?

units.rawText: This is no time for antics, Persi. There are lives at stake. Bonee-chan's cute and capable and all, but five's got to be a joke!
units.displayText: This is no time for antics, Persi. There are lives at stake. Bonee-chan's cute and capable and all, but five's got to be a joke!

units.rawText: But...
units.displayText: But...

units.displayText: Florence, the first batch of wounded has been settled in. We'll need...

spans.text: Florence, the first batch of wounded has been settled in. We'll need...

units.rawText: Alright, got it! I'll be right there!
units.displayText: Alright, got it! I'll be right there!

spans.text: Alright, got it! I'll be right there!

units.rawText: Agh... It hurts... someone help...
units.displayText: Agh... It hurts... someone help...

spans.text: Agh... It hurts... someone help...

units.displayText: The muffled sound of crying can be heard in the background, and it strikes Persicaria clean through the heart.

spans.text: The muffled sound of crying can be heard in the background, and it strikes Persicaria clean through the heart.

units.rawText: So, Persi, five's really not enough. Do you know just how many casualties there are? Send whatever you have.
units.displayText: So, Persi, five's really not enough. Do you know just how many casualties there are? Send whatever you have.

spans.text: So, Persi, five's really not enough. Do you know just how many casualties there are? Send whatever you have.

units.displayText: That's all I've got! I gotta go!

spans.text: That's all I've got! I gotta go!

units.displayText: The busy tone is still ringing. Phantasmal images of former friends dissipating into fragments of data appear in Persicaria's mind.

spans.text: The busy tone is still ringing. Phantasmal images of former friends dissipating into fragments of data appear in Persicaria's mind.

units.rawText: Persicaria, we have very little manpower available, and I think your previous decision was the correct one.

units.rawText: Ahh—Why must it be like this... Those Sanctifiers, why can't they just...

units.displayText: What should we do... Persicaria, save me...

units.rawText: Persicaria, I don't want to get reset like this... I still want to talk with everyone... I want to...
units.displayText: Persicaria, I don't want to get reset like this... I still want to talk with everyone... I want to...

spans.text: Persicaria, I don't want to get reset like this... I still want to talk with everyone... I want to...

units.displayText: I... but I...

spans.text: I... but I...

units.rawText: Don't worry, Persicaria.
units.displayText: Don't worry, Persicaria.

units.displayText: Horizon, dispatch twenty agents to the Medical Department.

units.displayText: Data backup center?!
